rows: exactly the (unit_id, week, horizon) rows of data/processed/app/eval_scores.parquet
weights: TabPFN v2 regressor (tabpfn-v2-regressor.ckpt, Prior-Labs/TabPFN-v2-reg, no licence gate); the tabpfn-time-series default v3.5 is gated (Prior Labs login / licence acceptance) and was not used
device: cuda (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, torch 2.11.0+cu128, CUDA 12.8)
runtime_note: sum over origins of this run; origins read from the cache are not re-timed
context: each unit's weekly log1p(incidence per 100k) for weeks <= origin, NaN weeks dropped (TabPFN-TS default)

covariates.type: known-future, lagged 4 weeks (values at weeks <= origin)

quantile_interpolation: none: the 23 FluSight levels are requested from TabPFN directly
leakage: zero-shot, no training; per-series in-context regression on weeks <= origin only
